concern: Urdu شاعروں (poets, plural) is romanised "Shairon" without the long aa; the corpus's own "shaair" (singular, 26:225 two verses later) keeps it. Without the long vowel, "Shairon" collides with شعر "sher/shair" (poem/couplet), a very common word -- reads as "the poems" rather than "the poets".
suggestion: Shaairon ki pairwi woh karte hain jo behke hue hon.
